propositions: An optional isolated backfill adapter must extract and deterministically classify error signatures from Claude Code transcript JSONL using regex/keyword matching (no LLM calls) into enum categories: env_setup, dependency, integration, tooling, none.
Classified records must carry source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified labels to signal low-confidence and segregate from authoritative structural metrics.
The adapter module must not be imported by core metrics packages (registry.py, __init__.py); portability is enforced by import-scan unit tests.
The backfill script must be directly exercised by tests over fixture transcript directories to ensure end-to-end extraction and emission of labeled classified intervals.

Classification routing must follow a deterministic priority table matching error patterns (ModuleNotFoundError→env_setup, pip conflicts→dependency, ConnectionError→integration, git/ruff/pytest→tooling) with first match wins and case-insensitive matching.
